title: Harden the test-skills lore agent profiles: the TS-34 Stage 1 findings 2 to 7
description:
Follow-up from the Stage 1 verdict on opum-ai/test-skills#57 (TS-34), recorded verbatim on the completed TS-34 record. Finding 1 (DEC-213 has no ADR) is a routing question taken to opum-doc and is not part of this task; see the ADR task. To Do, off the plan.

(2) MINOR: specs/engineering-rigor-profiles is excluded from every profile on the stated ground of keeping packs selective, but sources are task-ranked candidates, so exclusion buys no selectivity, only headroom under the capacity check; re-measure and consider adding it to review and verification (the runbook remedy for capacity is to re-budget up). (3) MINOR: max_tokens was not swept; the runbook prescribes a 3 to 4 task sweep with the no-source-scoring-9-or-more-omitted test; record the task texts. (4) MINOR: the AC3 evidence recorded a count (11) not rule names and severities before and after; record the lore check --json rule tallies on both refs, the exact commands and the resolved lore version. (5) MINOR: this repo has no lore CI job, so nothing validates .lore/agents and one bad reference breaks lore agent list for every role; add a CI step that runs lore agent list (or lore check strict). That is a workflow edit and floor work (DEC-182), so it needs its own word. (6) NIT: adr/0001 is absent from the review profile sources. (7) MINOR: acceptance criteria were first written in the closing commit; record criteria before work on tasks like this.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The engineering-rigor spec exclusion is re-measured and the decision recorded (added to review and verification, or kept out with the measurement).
A max_tokens sweep over 3 to 4 task texts is recorded per profile.
Rule tallies of lore check on both refs, with commands and lore version, are recorded.
A CI step running lore agent list is added with its own floor approval, or declined with a reason.
adr/0001 is added to the review sources or its omission is recorded.
